name: stellate
description: A generative music instrument you play by moving through a map of 274 genres — every song rendered live in the browser and fully deterministic from a seed.

scripts.test:pure: node test/gates/theory.test.js && node test/gates/pipes.test.js && node test/gates/boot-smoke.test.js

//: Every gate is named <name>.test.js and the FOLDER says what it needs: test/gates (the verify.sh suite), test/unit (pure node), test/browser + test/starcruise (real WebGL/WebAudio via Playwright), test/probes (hand-run instruments, *.probe.js), test/lib (shared harnesses, not gates). The MATRIX/VALIDATE/ENGINE gates (verify.sh) and everything under test/gates + test/unit need NO deps beyond Node. test:browser globs exactly the two browser folders; they need this one devDependency: run `npm install` then `npm run setup:browser`, after which `node test/browser/<name>.test.js` works with no NODE_PATH. Faust's own build dep installs separately under engine/faust (see CONTRIBUTING).
